mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public_booking_requests WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM public_booking_requests WHERE cancel_token_hash = #{tokenHash} FOR UPDATE
SELECT * FROM public_booking_requests WHERE status = 'pending' ORDER BY hold_expires_at, id
SELECT * FROM public_booking_requests WHERE status = 'pending' AND hold_expires_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id FOR UPDATE

SELECT r.id, r.reservation_no, r.room_id, r.customer_id, r.booking_request_id, rooms.room_number, rooms.room_name, rooms.cleaning_status AS room_cleaning_status, r.check_in_date, r.check_out_date, r.checked_in_at, r.checked_out_at, r.guest_name, r.guest_kana, r.guest_gender, r.guest_age, r.guest_phone, r.guest_email, r.guest_count, r.reservation_form, r.payment_status, r.reservation_status, r.total_amount, r.note, r.cancellation_reason, r.cancelled_by, r.cancelled_at, COALESCE(string_agg(rg.guest_name || '（' || COALESCE(CAST(rg.guest_age AS varchar), '未入力') || '歳）', E'\n' ORDER BY rg.id), '') AS companion_summary, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM reservations r JOIN rooms ON rooms.id = r.room_id LEFT JOIN reservation_guests rg ON rg.reservation_id = r.id WHERE r.booking_request_id = #{bookingRequestId} GROUP BY r.id, rooms.room_number, rooms.room_name, rooms.cleaning_status ORDER BY rooms.room_number, r.id
mapper.update: UPDATE public_booking_requests SET status = #{status}, rejection_reason = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'rejected' THEN #{reason} ELSE rejection_reason END, confirmed_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'confirmed' THEN #{now} ELSE confirmed_at END, rejected_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'rejected' THEN #{now} ELSE rejected_at END, cancelled_at = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'cancelled' THEN #{now} ELSE cancelled_at END, cancellation_reason = CASE WHEN #{status} = 'cancelled' THEN #{reason} ELSE cancellation_reason END, updated_at = #{now} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{expectedStatus}
